repo_notes.content: Lexicon (@ashlr/lexicon) is a TypeScript, Node.js and ESM personal lexicon that corrects speech-to-text transcripts before they reach agents. Source is the ground truth: src/core contains matching, storage and trust; src/cli and src/mcp expose it; src/hooks supplies Claude Code hooks. Explain data flow with diagrams and cite source files. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md explains design decisions and docs/CONTRACT.md describes the public API.
Distinguish global and trusted project lexicons, and explain preview and explicit application for agent-initiated writes. Do not include secret values, personal transcripts or real machine paths.
